question: In January 2022, which of these IITs launched the Global Center of Excellence in Affordable and Clean Energy (GCoE-ACE)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**IIT Dharwad**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **IIT Dharwad** launched the Global Center of Excellence in Affordable and Clean Energy (GCoE-ACE) in January 2022.
 
• The center aims to focus on research and development in the field of affordable and clean energy.
 
• It seeks to address the energy needs of underserved communities and contribute to sustainable development goals.
 
• The initiative is part of IIT Dharwad's commitment to innovation and excellence in energy solutions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **IIT Dharwad** is one of the newer IITs established by the Government of India to expand access to high-quality technical education.
 
• The institution focuses on fostering innovation, research, and collaboration across various fields of engineering and technology.
 
• The launch of the GCoE-ACE aligns with India's broader goals of promoting clean and sustainable energy solutions.
 
• The center will collaborate with various stakeholders, including government agencies, industry partners, and international organizations, to achieve its objectives.
